# Rounded inward reentrant join

The stock is an L-shaped prism of height 6. The inward cavity is 5 high
and its cross-section is the sharp cavity from `shells/concave-sharp`
plus the unit corner square outside a radius-1 quadrant centred at
(4, 4). The added area is 1 − π/4. Two one-unit wall runs give way to a
quarter circle of length π/2. The inner floor and rim together equal
the stock's section area. Symmetry exchanges x and y. The removed
quarter disk has first moment π − 1/3 in each of those coordinates.

The oracle builds the rounded interior and the arris wheel intersects
the two offset planes. The strict regression expects the arc geometry.
